newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN IPO - ORV Castings Ltd, opens Feb 3.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN IPO - ORV Castings Ltd, opens Feb 3.

text.p: The following initial public issue (IPO) by India's ORV Castings Ltd is expected to be open for public subscription on Monday, February 3:
Face value Rs 10 per share value
Post Issue Holding of Promoters 39.00 percent.

The Karnataka-based ORV castings Ltd is issuing equity shares aggregating 44.30 million rupees. The company is engaged in the manufacture of precision castings of carbon steel, alloy steel, stainless steel castings. These find application in the manufacture of process pumps and valves, mining equipment parts, earth moving equipments and engineering goods. The project is for an expansion of the installed capacity from 720 TPA to 2760 TPA.

The working capital in the present issue has been estimated at 85 percent capacity utilisation even though the current capacity utilisation is 60 percent. The OPM and the NPM work out 20.7 and 5.5 percent respectively.
